title: Sebastian and the Colony
author: Lior Ravensworth
blurb: Mirabel Crane, a clone who inherited the original's murder case, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. But when the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise before Earth's last transmission loop ends.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
